pricing_model_rules.calculation_formula: Price = Selected Pages Count × Cost per Page Mode (₹2 or ₹10) × Number of Copies (1-20). Note: Double-sided printing halves sheets used (ceil(pages/2)), while price remains based on total printed pages.

stepper_workflow.title: Print & Download
stepper_workflow.subtitle: Collect print or download prepared PDF

layout_and_grids.kiosk_mode_toggle: Provides dual-mode experience: Mobile User Mode (step-by-step phone view) & Terminal Kiosk Mode (full-screen station display with enlarged QR code for patron scanning)
layout_and_grids.mobile_optimization: All bottom sheets, action buttons, and price summaries stick with backdrop blur for effortless 1-handed thumb reach on 375px+ devices

motion_and_microinteractions.sheet_flip_animation: Subtle visual cue when toggling between single-sided and double-sided sheets
motion_and_microinteractions.price_countup: Instant live price badge highlight with pulse on option toggle
motion_and_microinteractions.progress_shimmer: Animated gradient shimmer on document upload and printing generation bars

accessibility_rules.contrast: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against their declared surface backgrounds
accessibility_rules.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, file dropzones, tab triggers, price summaries, and tokens MUST have distinct data-testid attributes
accessibility_rules.screen_readers: All icon-only buttons include aria-label; status updates (uploading, price change, timer countdown) are marked with aria-live='polite'

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the existing Flask backend routes (/upload, /calculate, /pay, /download/<filename>, /status) without modifying app.py or backend logic.
Implement the React frontend in /app/frontend/src/App.tsx and modular components under /app/frontend/src/components/.
Provide a realistic interactive simulation mode that connects smoothly to Flask API endpoints or local state fallbacks with seamless error recovery.
Feature a prominent Auto-Cleanup 10-Minute Countdown Clock with visual amber/red warning badges to assure customer privacy.
Add a dedicated 'Kiosk Display Mode' switch in the header so shop owners can put it on a counter tablet/monitor with a giant QR code for patrons to scan and open on mobile.
Support flexible page selections: 'all', comma-separated ('1, 3, 5'), ranges ('1-4'), and combinations ('1-3, 5, 8'). Provide instant validation with visual total page count.
Display a transparent, itemized pricing breakdown: Base Price (₹2 or ₹10) × Pages × Copies = Total INR ₹ with Sheet Count badge.
Include simulated demo payments with simulated UPI QR (Google Pay / PhonePe / Paytm styling) and Card options that simulate instant zero-friction confirmation.
Enable immediate PDF download and print completion token voucher generation.
